goal: Parse a duration string like '1h30m' or '45s' into total seconds
assumptions: Units may appear in any order (e.g., '30m1h', '45s').
Each unit appears at most once in the string.
The string is non-empty and contains at least one valid unit.
Numbers preceding units are non-negative integers.
The function returns an integer representing total seconds.
No whitespace or other characters are present in the input string.
If a unit is omitted, its value is 0.
